VELA was built around a simple idea: the best pieces are the ones you actually want to wear.

We select contemporary clothing designed to move between real parts of your life — the office, brunch, dinner, birthdays, weekends and everything in between.

Based in Abuja, we make finding something you love and getting it to you as simple as possible.
